title: Children’s Park, Gandhinagar - A Fun-Filled Destination for Families
content:
Children’s Park, Gandhinagar

Located in the heart of Gandhinagar, Children’s Park is one of the city’s most popular recreational spots for families and kids. Spread across a lush green area, this park offers a perfect blend of fun, relaxation, and natural beauty. With toy trains, boating facilities, amusement rides, and open play zones, it’s an ideal destination for a cheerful weekend outing. The park also features walking tracks, gardens, and a mini lake, making it enjoyable for visitors of all ages.

The serene atmosphere and vibrant activities make Children’s Park not just a playground for kids, but also a peaceful escape for adults seeking a refreshing break from the city rush. Whether you’re visiting with family or friends, the park promises joyful moments surrounded by greenery and laughter.

Visiting Time

  • Timing: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM
  • Best Time to Visit: Evenings and weekends, especially during winter months.

Entry Fee

  • Entry Fee: ₹10 per person (approx.)
  • Toy Train Ride: ₹20 per person (approx.)

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Indroda Nature Park - Known as India’s Jurassic Park, perfect for nature and wildlife lovers.
  • Sarita Udyan - A peaceful riverside garden ideal for picnics.
  • Akshardham Temple - A majestic spiritual and architectural landmark of Gandhinagar.
  • Adalaj Stepwell - An iconic historical monument just a short drive away.
